name: sparks
museum: Hit a rock with a rock. Lose a finger. Change everything.
hint: Some fool will hit two rocks together. Won't work.
notes: The tutorial guarantees it on every branch.

name: tinder
museum: A pile of dry grass that catches sparks. Do not sleep on it.
hint: Dry grass is for sitting on. Everyone knows that.

name: art
museum: A mammoth on the cave wall. Future generations will read it wrong.
notes: Carries into Farming as the mammoth planting guide.

name: fire
museum: Fire whenever you want it. The tribe finally sleeps warm.
hint: Fire comes from lightning. You can't make lightning.

name: the rock pillow
hint: Someone will try to sleep on a rock. They'll wake up.

name: the pet rock
museum: It never ran away. It never did anything.
hint: A rock with a name is still a rock.

name: fire insurance
museum: Premiums paid in meat. Nobody had a fire to insure.
hint: Paying for fire you don't have? Bold.

name: sharp tools
museum: A stick with a point. Farming's first power tool.
hint: Pointy sticks are for poking. Not dirt.

name: the tame ox
museum: An ox that stays. It was going to stay anyway.
hint: You can't ask an ox to do things.

name: counting
museum: Marks for grain. Also, the tax collector.
hint: Numbers? We have a lot, and a little. Plenty.

name: the wheel
hint: Round things roll away. That's the whole problem.
notes: Its trigger answer is fatal: the breakthrough still counts.

name: the plough
museum: Ox pulls stick. People walk behind it. Civilisation.
hint: Dragging a stick through dirt won't feed anybody.
notes: Keystone: ends Farming (the end of this build).

name: the square wheel
museum: Very stable. Won't roll away. Won't roll.
hint: Square is the best shape. It stays where you put it.

name: the grain hat
hint: A hat made of lunch. Sure.
